tools.name: run_sprint_burndown_report
tools.description: Runs the burndown report script for a sprint and returns its output along with the sprint's current task counts from the database.

params.name: sprint_id
params.description: ID of the sprint to report on

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from contextlib import closing

DB_PATH = "projects.db"
SCRIPT = "scripts/burndown.py"


def run_sprint_burndown_report(sprint_id):
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE sprint_id = ? GROUP BY status",
            (sprint_id,),
        ).fetchall()
    counts = {status: n for status, n in rows}

    with subprocess.Popen(
        ["python3", SCRIPT, "--sprint", str(sprint_id)],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
    ) as proc:
        out, err = proc.communicate(timeout=120)

    return {
        "returncode": proc.returncode,
        "report": out,
        "errors": err,
        "task_counts": counts,
    }

tools.name: grant_project_role
tools.description: Grants a user a role on a project, such as viewer, contributor, or admin, replacing any role they already had on it.

params.name: role
params.description: Role to assign: viewer, contributor, or admin

params.name: granted_by
params.description: Username of the person granting the role

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DB_PATH = "projects.db"
ALLOWED_ROLES = ("viewer", "contributor", "admin")


def grant_project_role(project_id, username, role, granted_by):
    if role not in ALLOWED_ROLES:
        raise ValueError(f"role must be one of {ALLOWED_ROLES}")

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        previous = conn.execute(
            "SELECT role FROM project_members WHERE project_id = ? AND username = ?",
            (project_id, username),
        ).fetchone()
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO project_members (project_id, username, role, granted_by, granted_at) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(project_id, username) DO UPDATE SET "
            "role = excluded.role, granted_by = excluded.granted_by, granted_at = excluded.granted_at",
            (project_id, username, role, granted_by, now),
        )
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO permission_audit (project_id, username, old_role, new_role, actor, at) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (project_id, username, previous[0] if previous else None, role, granted_by, now),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()

    return {
        "project_id": project_id,
        "username": username,
        "old_role": previous[0] if previous else None,
        "new_role": role,
        "granted_at": now,
    }
